Prototyping for Technical Designers

Prototyping for Technical Designers develops your ability to turn a gameplay brief into a focused, playable technical prototype. Building on your Unity and C# experience, you will investigate a technical question, design connected gameplay systems and explain how those systems support the intended player experience.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Demonstrate the requirements of Advanced Games Technical Design Documentation within a modern game industry setting.

+  Develop Systems that solve problems for an Advanced Games Technical Design Project using academic and industry research.

+  Defend the developed systems in a manner that meets industry requirements.

+  Critically reflect on the developed systems and compare the project against industry contemporaries.
